title: Cardiac MRI-informed electrocardiography enables biologically grounded cardiomyopathy detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.23925v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Precise myocardial phenotyping at population scale is limited by the cost and accessibility of cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR), whereas electrocardiography (ECG) is widely available but reflects electrical rather than structural and functional information. Here we develop MyoECG, a cross-modal representation learning framework that distils myocardial structural and functional knowledge from CMR into standard 12-lead ECGs, enabling imaging-informed cardiomyopathy detection and subtype classification from ECGs alone. MyoECG was pretrained on 45,241 paired ECG-CMR examinations from UK Biobank and a tertiary cardiovascular centre, then developed and validated across more than 1.8 million ECGs from seven independent datasets. Across internal and external datasets spanning prevalences of 0.2-54.7%, MyoECG outperformed five pretrained ECG foundation models, with AUROCs of 0.800-0.974 for cardiomyopathy detection. translated_title: 心脏磁共振信息引导的心电图实现具有生物学依据的心肌病检测
translated_abstract: 在人群规模上进行精确的心肌表型分析受到心脏磁共振（CMR）成本高和可及性有限的制约，而心电图（ECG）虽然广泛应用，但仅反映电学信息而非结构和功能信息。在本研究中，我们开发了MyoECG，这是一个跨模态表征学习框架，能够将CMR中的心肌结构和功能知识蒸馏到标准12导联心电图中，从而仅凭心电图即可实现基于影像信息的心肌病检测和亚型分类。MyoECG在英国生物样本库和一家三级心血管中心的45,241对ECG-CMR配对检查数据上进行了预训练，随后在来自七个独立数据集的超过180万份心电图上进行开发和验证。在患病率为0.2%-54.7%的内部和外部数据集中，MyoECG的表现优于五个预训练心电图基础模型，心肌病检测的AUROC达到0.800-0.974。在一项由六名（读者参与的多读者研究中……）
tldr: 该研究提出MyoECG跨模态表征学习框架，将心脏磁共振中的心肌结构和功能知识蒸馏到标准12导联心电图中，使仅凭心电图即可实现具有生物学依据的心肌病检测和亚型分类，并在七个独立数据集超过180万份心电图中验证其优于现有心电图基础模型。
